descriptionFromApi:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It s a unique legacy of innovation that s fueled by great technology-and amazing people. Today, we re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. We are now looking for ASIC Flow and Integration Engineer to drive design methodology, automation, and integration for our High Speed IO team.

What youll be doing:

As one of the primary methodology engineer, you ll work across all NVIDIA-delivered projects, owning the integration process and collaborating with global teams to define and implement best-in-class methodologies. You ll operate beyond RTL coding-building infrastructure and systems that are modular, reusable, and easily deployable across diverse silicon platforms. During the course of a project you would end up driving the following aspects of:

  • Own the full-chip and block-level integration process across multiple NVIDIA SoC and GPU projects.

  • Stitch together RTL units and ensure seamless connectivity, and hierarchy management.

  • Define and evolve internal design methodologies to improve scalability, quality, and turnaround time.

  • Build automation pipelines using Python/Perl to streamline integration, debug, and delivery.

  • Develop modular and reusable systems that can be easily delivered and adapted across different SoC and GPU architectures.

  • Collaborate extensively with RTL, verification, physical design, and architecture teams to ensure flow compatibility and design readiness.

  • Drive full-chip debug efforts, connectivity, and functional issues across multiple hierarchies and technology nodes.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of internal standards and mentor engineers on flow usage and integration practices.

What we need to see:

  • BS or B. Tech or MS or M. tech in EE, ECE, CS, or equivalent degree with 2+ years or more experience in design integration and methodologies for ASIC design.

  • Comprehensive understanding of IP development flows, build flows is a must

  • Excellent influencing skills resulting in collaboration with cross-cultural, multi geography and matrixed teams

  • Good debugging, analytical and problem solving skills

  • Great interpersonal skills and ability to work as an excellent teammate

  • Working exposure with AI tools like Claude and Cursor would be a plus

We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us. If youre creative and independent, with a genuine real passion for technology and improving the state of art, we want to hear from you! Widely considered to be one of the technology world s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www. nvidiabenefits. com/

We are seeking an experienced Lead Developer - Salesforce to join our technology team and drive the design, development , integration , deployment , and continuous improvement of Salesforce solutions . This role is ideal for a hands -on technical leader who enjoys building scalable Salesforce applications , mentoring developers , collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders , and delivering high-quality solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Salesforce CPQ

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Salesforce development activities across configuration , customization , Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, automation , integrations , and platform enhancements .

  • Design and deliver scalable , secure , maintainable , and high- performing Salesforce solutions that improve user experience and enable end-to-end business processes .

  • Translate business requirements into technical designs , reusable components , integration patterns , and implementation approaches aligned with platform standards .

  • Provide technical leadership to developers through mentoring , code reviews , design guidance , troubleshooting support, and enforcement of Salesforce development best practices .

  • Work closely with architects , business analysts , QA teams , product owners , and stakeholders to estimate work , manage dependencies , support testing , and deliver high-quality Salesforce releases .

  • Contribute to release planning , deployment validation , documentation , technical governance , and continuous improvement of Salesforce delivery processes .

Required s kills and Experience

  • 6+ years of hands -on Salesforce development experience , including at least 2 years in a Lead Developer , Tech Lead, or similar technical leadership role .

  • Strong experience with Agile delivery , Scrum practices , DevOps processes , CI/CD, release governance , and tools such as JIRA .

  • Experience with leveraging AI- powered development tools to accelerate the software development lifecycle , including requirements analysis , code generation , testing , documentation , and productivity optimization , while adhering to organizational guardrails , security policies , compliance requirements, data privacy standards , and responsible AI usage guidelines .

  • Knowledge of Salesforce Agentforce and AI capabilities to design, build, and deploy AI-driven solutions, including AI agents, automation, prompt engineering, and integration with Salesforce platform services.

  • Proven ability to lead Salesforce development teams , conduct code reviews , mentor developers , manage technical risks , and ensure delivery quality .

  • Strong practical knowledge of Salesforce platform capabilities , including configuration , customization , automation , security , data model , integrations , and scalable solution design.

  • Hands-on expertise in Apex, triggers , batch Apex, scheduled Apex, queueable Apex, SOQL, SOSL, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce , and Salesforce development patterns .

  • Experience with declarative tools such as Flows, validation rules , approval processes , profiles , permission sets , roles , users , page layouts , record types , and dynamic forms .

  • Strong understanding of Salesforce objects , governor limits , transaction boundaries , code coverage , performance optimization , security model , sharing rules , and data visibility concepts .

  • Experience with Salesforce development tools and deployment utilities such as Visual Studio Code, Salesforce CLI, Data Loader, Workbench , Data Import Wizard, metadata deployment tools, Copado, Bitbucket , and Git .

  • Strong experience in Lightning Web Components , JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and modern front -end development standards within the Salesforce ecosystem .

  • Good knowledge of Salesforce CPQ, including product configuration , pricing, quoting processes , customization , and integration scenarios .

  • Knowledge of Salesforce Experience Cloud, including customer and partner portals , user access , branding , navigation , and portal- specific development considerations .

  • Experience with REST and SOAP APIs, middleware integrations , platform events , outbound messages , connected apps, authentication mechanisms , and integration error -handling patterns .

  • Ability to collaborate with business users , product owners , architects , QA teams , and cross-functional stakeholders to clarify requirements, support UAT, plan releases , and provide post-release support.

  • Excellent communication , analytical , troubleshooting , and organizational skills , with the ability to work independently

  • Preferred Qualifications and Attributes

  • Bachelor s or Master s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, MCA, or a related discipline .

  • Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II, Administrator, Platform App Builder , Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, or CPQ Specialist are preferred .

  • Experience working in global, distributed , or cross-cultural teams .

  • Strong ownership mindset , collaborative working style, and ability to lead by example within a technical delivery team.

  • Good communication skills , including speaking , writing , presentation , and stakeholder interaction .

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to lead impactful Salesforce initiatives across business-critical CRM processes.

  • A collaborative environment with exposure to global teams, modern Salesforce capabilities, Agile delivery, and DevOps practices.

  • A role that combines hands-on development, technical leadership, stakeholder collaboration, and continuous learning.

Why Join ZEISS

At ZEISS, you will be part of a globally respected technology company known for innovation , precision , and solving meaningful challenges across industries such as healthcare , research , manufacturing , and vision care. We offer an environment where technology professionals can work on impactful digital transformation initiatives, collaborate with global teams , and contribute to solutions that support business growth and customer excellence.

Joining ZEISS means working in a culture that values ownership , continuous learning, quality , and collaboration . You will have opportunities to grow your technical expertise , take leadership responsibilities , explore modern Salesforce capabilities , and be part of a purpose-driven organization that encourages innovation and long -term career development .
